origin:
ProSport Racing emerged from the close-knit motorsport community of Bavaria in the late 1990s. It began as a passion project of local engineer, Dieter Schmidt, who, along with a group of friends and fellow racing enthusiasts, pooled their resources to build a competitive car for regional touring car events. Their early days were marked by late nights in a cramped garage, scavenging parts from junkyards, and a relentless dedication to improving their self-built machine. A pivotal moment came in 2003, when, against all odds, they secured a surprise victory at the Sachsenring, instantly cementing their place as a team to watch in the regional racing scene.

Schmidt's initial vision was to provide a platform for young, talented drivers who were often overlooked by the bigger, wealthier teams. This commitment to nurturing talent has remained a core aspect of ProSport Racing's identity, even as they have grown and developed. Though they have often been outspent by their rivals, ProSport has consistently punched above its weight, relying on ingenuity, teamwork, and a deep understanding of car dynamics to stay competitive.
philosophy: ProSport Racing's philosophy centers around continuous improvement and a collaborative team environment. They approach car development with a blend of meticulous engineering and driver feedback, constantly refining their setup to extract every last bit of performance. Team culture is paramount; they foster a sense of camaraderie and mutual respect, believing that a united and motivated team can overcome any challenge. Their 'never give up' attitude is well known in the regional paddock.
achievements: 2003: Victory at the Sachsenring (Regional Touring Car Championship)
Multiple podium finishes in the ADAC GT Masters support races (2010-2015)
2018: Second place in the DMV Touring Car Challenge
Consistent top-ten finishes in VLN Endurance Championship races

teamPrincipal.name: Dieter Schmidt
teamPrincipal.background: Dieter Schmidt is a self-taught engineer with a passion for motorsport. His hands-on approach and unwavering dedication have been instrumental in ProSport Racing's success, fostering a family-like atmosphere within the team.

keyFigures.name: Klaus Richter
keyFigures.description: Klaus Richter is the backbone of the ProSport Racing garage. His decades of experience and encyclopedic knowledge of car mechanics are invaluable to the team.

keyFigures.name: Lena Meyer
keyFigures.description: A rising star in the engineering world, Lena Meyer brings a modern, data-driven approach to ProSport's racing strategy. Her innovative solutions have often given the team a competitive edge.

headquarters: ProSport Racing operates out of a modest workshop on the outskirts of Nuremberg. Their facilities are basic but well-maintained, featuring a small fabrication area, a dyno room, and a dedicated space for car preparation.
fanBase: ProSport Racing enjoys a loyal following among local motorsport enthusiasts. Their fans appreciate the team's underdog spirit, their commitment to developing young talent, and their approachable, down-to-earth attitude. They are often seen sporting the team's colors at regional races, passionately cheering on their local heroes.
